'''Thull's Vault''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Thull's Vault system/Legends|Thull's Vault system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Arporatal-Lanin system/Legends|Arporatal-Lanin]] and [[Talhovi system/Legends|Talhovi systems]]. The planet's surface featured luminescent sands.<ref name="TEA" />

Thull's Vault shared its name with [[Thull Vandron]], a [[Currency/Legends|wealthy]] entrepreneur from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Axum]] who spearheaded the [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]] of the Senex-Juvex around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The former world eventually came under the control of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]], and, according to legend, a [[Unidentified House Carbinol noble|noble]] of [[House Carbinol]] once scuttled an ancient [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[treasure ship]]s under the glowing sands of Thull's Vault.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thull's Vault was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and placed it in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
